name: ATO Training Manual
description: Training manual for an approved training organisation, laid out in the common Part A–E structure (general, flight training, synthetic training, theoretical knowledge, tests and checks).

chapters.goal: Set out the manual's purpose, amendment procedure, course objectives, entry requirements and the responsibilities of training staff.
Describe the course structure, phases, sequence of instruction and the time allocated to each element.

chapters.title_en: Part A — Student Progress and Records
chapters.title_ka: ნაწილი A — სტუდენტის პროგრესი და ჩანაწერები
chapters.goal: Explain how progress is assessed, what records are kept, and what happens when a student does not meet the standard.
Specify each flight lesson: objectives, briefing content, exercises, completion standards and the instructor's role.
Specify each simulator or FSTD session, the device used, its objectives and completion standards.
Set out the theoretical syllabus by subject, the teaching methods, study material and the hours per subject.
Describe progress tests, skill tests and theoretical examinations, who conducts them and the pass criteria.

chapters.title_en: Safety and Threat & Error Management in Training
chapters.title_ka: უსაფრთხოება და საფრთხეებისა და შეცდომების მართვა სწავლებისას
chapters.goal: Show how the organisation integrates TEM, human factors and its safety management into day-to-day training.

name: OSH Course Book
description: Course book for an occupational safety and health training programme: legal framework, risk assessment, common hazards, emergency response and assessment.

chapters.title_en: Introduction to Occupational Safety and Health
chapters.goal: Explain why OSH matters, the cost of workplace accidents and ill health, and how the course is organised.
Set out the national OSH law and related international standards, and the duties of employers, specialists and workers.
Teach a practical method to identify hazards, rate risk and choose controls using the hierarchy of controls.
Explain when PPE is the right control, how to select, fit, maintain and inspect it, and its limits.
Cover planning, fall prevention and fall arrest, ladders and scaffolds, and rescue planning.
Describe the main mechanisms of harm and the standard controls, including isolation and safe handling.
Explain fire prevention, evacuation, emergency plans and drills, and the roles people take in an emergency.
Give workers the first actions to take after an injury until trained help arrives, within the limits of their training.
Explain what must be reported, how to investigate root causes, and how lessons are fed back into risk assessment.
Summarise key learning points and describe how learners are assessed and certified.

name: Operations Manual
description: Air operator operations manual in the common four-part layout: general, aircraft operating matters, route and aerodrome, and training.

chapters.title_en: Part A — Administration and Control of the Manual
chapters.title_ka: ნაწილი A — სახელმძღვანელოს ადმინისტრირება და კონტროლი
chapters.goal: Explain how the manual is issued, amended, distributed and controlled.
Describe the organisational structure, nominated persons and the duties of operations personnel.

chapters.title_en: Part A — Operational Control and Supervision
chapters.title_ka: ნაწილი A — ოპერატიული კონტროლი და ზედამხედველობა
chapters.goal: Explain how flights are authorised, supervised and controlled.

chapters.title_en: Part A — Flight Time and Fatigue Management
chapters.title_ka: ნაწილი A — ფრენის დრო და დაღლილობის მართვა
chapters.goal: Set out flight and duty time limits, rest requirements and how fatigue is managed.
Describe flight preparation, fuel policy, weather minima, and normal operating procedures.

chapters.title_ka: ნაწილი B — საჰაერო ხომალდის საოპერაციო საკითხები
chapters.goal: Provide type-related limitations, normal, abnormal and emergency procedures, performance and mass and balance.

chapters.title_en: Part C — Route, Role, Area and Aerodrome Instructions
chapters.title_ka: ნაწილი C — მარშრუტის, არეალისა და აეროდრომის ინსტრუქციები
chapters.goal: Give route and aerodrome information and minima needed to plan and conduct flights.
Describe training programmes and checking for all operations personnel.

name: Safety Management System Manual
description: SMS manual organised around the ICAO framework of four components: safety policy and objectives, safety risk management, safety assurance and safety promotion.

chapters.goal: State the safety policy, objectives and the accountable manager's commitment.

chapters.title_en: Safety Accountabilities and Key Safety Personnel
chapters.goal: Define who is accountable for safety, the safety manager role and safety committees.
Explain how the emergency response plan is coordinated with other organisations and exercised.
Describe how SMS documents and safety records are controlled and retained.
Describe reactive, proactive and predictive methods used to identify hazards, including the reporting system.
Set out the risk matrix, tolerability criteria and how mitigations are chosen and tracked.
Define safety performance indicators, targets, alert levels and how they are reviewed.
Explain how changes are assessed for safety risk before they are introduced.
Describe audits, reviews and how findings improve the system.
Set out SMS training for all staff and how safety information is communicated.

name: Instructor Handbook
description: Handbook for flight or OSH instructors: standardisation, lesson planning, briefing and debriefing, assessment and instructor conduct.

chapters.title_en: Role and Standards of the Instructor
chapters.goal: Define what the organisation expects of its instructors and how standardisation is maintained.
Give instructors practical principles of adult learning, motivation and skill acquisition.
Show how to plan a lesson with clear objectives, structure, timing and completion standards.
Teach effective pre-lesson briefings and facilitative debriefings.

chapters.title_en: Human Factors and Threat & Error Management
chapters.title_ka: ადამიანური ფაქტორები და საფრთხეებისა და შეცდომების მართვა
chapters.goal: Show how to teach and assess non-technical skills alongside technical ones.
Explain grading criteria, fair assessment and feedback that improves performance.
Set out the instructor's duties for safety during training and how to report hazards and occurrences.

name: OSH Induction Booklet
description: Short induction booklet for new workers: site rules, key hazards, emergency procedures and how to raise concerns.

chapters.goal: Tell new workers what they can expect from the employer and their right to raise concerns and stop unsafe work.
List the rules every worker must follow on this site and why.
Describe the main hazards workers will meet and the controls in place.
Explain alarms, evacuation routes, assembly points and first aid arrangements.
Explain how and to whom to report incidents, near misses and concerns.
